
# Pobieranie i czyszczenie danych

## Pobieranie mapy

```{r}
alps_map <- ne_countries(country = c("Switzerland", "Germany", "Italy"),
                         scale = "medium",
                         returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r}
tatra_map <- ne_countries(country =c( "Poland", "Slovakia"),
                            scale = "medium",
                            returnclass = "sf")
```

## Pobranie danych

```{r}
lista_gatunków <- read.csv("gatunki.csv",header = TRUE, sep = ";")
lista_gatunków
```

|                    |                                       |
|:-------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Cochlearia tatrae  | tylko tatry i 1 norwegia              |
| Draba siliquosa    | dużo alp i kazbek                     |
| Draba dubia        | dużo alp                              |
| Draba fladnizensis | dużo wszędzie mało tatry              |
| Draba tomentosa    | dużo alpy mało tatry                  |
| Woodsia alpina     | dużo wszędzie mało tatry              |
| Woodsia pulchella  | mało alpy, brak tatry, trochę bajkał? |
| Poa granitica      | brak alpy głównie tatry               |

```{r}
sp_name <- "Draba dubia	"
sp_tatrea <- name_backbone(name = sp_name)
sp_key <- sp_tatrea$usageKey
sp_key
```

```{r}
occ_count(taxonKey = sp_key)
```

```{r}
gbif_download_key <- occ_download(pred("taxonKey", sp_key),
                              format = "SIMPLE_CSV",
                             user = "kajsyr",
                             pwd = "BiojestOK+05",
                             email = "jan.rysiak@student.uj.edu.pl")
```

```{r}
occ_download_wait(gbif_download_key)

gbif_download <- occ_download_get(gbif_download_key, 
                                  overwrite = TRUE) %>% 
                 occ_download_import() %>% 
                 setNames(tolower(names(.)))

head(gbif_download, 10) 
```

```{r}
head(data$data)
```

```{r}
gbif_download %>% count(countrycode)
```

```{r}
gbif_tatry<- gbif_download %>% filter(countrycode==c("SK", "PL"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = tatra_map) +
  geom_point(data = gbif_tatry,
             aes(x = decimallongitude,
                 y = decimallatitude),
             shape = "+",
             color = "red") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
gbif_alps<- gbif_download %>% filter(countrycode==c("DE", "IT", "CH"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = alps_map) +
  geom_point(data = gbif_alps,
             aes(x = decimallongitude,
                 y = decimallatitude),
             shape = "+",
             color = "red") +
  theme_bw()
```
